description: javax.servlet relocates to jakarta.servlet at the Boot 3 boundary. javax.crypto does not relocate, and a matcher that keys on the 'javax.' prefix rather than on the 26 packages that actually moved will wrongly flag CryptoUtil.
ground_truth_source: Hand-declared by inspection of the tree below. The harness runs ImpactStage's matcher over the tree and compares its output to this list; the fixture never states what the matcher should predict.
